T016 : ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (V n)),
  ((0 ≤ dimH E ∧ dimH E ≤ ↑n) ∧
      dimH E ≠ ∞ ∧
        Bornology.IsBounded E ∧
          (∃ R, 1 ≤ R ∧ ∀ x ∈ E, ∀ (j : Fin n), |x.ofLp j| ≤ R) ∧
            (∀ (s δ : ℝ), 0 < s → 0 < δ → content s δ E < ∞) ∧
              (n = 0 → E = univ ∧ dimH E = 0) ∧
                (Function.Bijective fun p => join p.1 p.2) ∧
                  (∀ (x : V n) (t : ℝ), base (join x t) = x ∧ height (join x t) = t) ∧
                    (∀ (z : V (n + 1)), join (base z) (height z) = z) ∧
                      ∀ (x y : V n) (t u : ℝ), dist (join x t) (join y u) ^ 2 = dist x y ^ 2 + dist t u ^ 2) →
    LipschitzWith 1 base ∧
      LipschitzWith 1 height ∧
        ∀ (δ : ℝ) (W : ℕ → Set (V (n + 1))),
          0 < δ →
            scaleCover δ (_root_.cylinder E) W →
              ∀ (i : ℕ),
                Metric.ediam (W i) = ENNReal.ofReal (Metric.diam (W i)) ∧
                  0 ≤ Metric.diam (W i) ∧
                    Metric.diam (W i) ≤ δ ∧
                      Metric.ediam (base '' W i) ≤ Metric.ediam (W i) ∧
                        Metric.ediam (height '' W i) ≤ Metric.ediam (W i)
'Translation.T016' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
